name: Titsui
description: Nishang's late second-in-command, a purple vulture-like warrior whose form is impersonated by a rakshasa; the real Titsui was murdered by a Sultai priest.

timeline.summary: Nishang, rotting from a wasting disease, rants in a tavern against the new Sultai order that makes sibsig an honor.
timeline.quote: They made being a sib an honor now and gave all our captives rest.
